name: Core text editing with marks, blocks, and undo/redo
description: Type, delete, select, split and merge blocks; bold/italic/underline; H1/H2/paragraph; transaction-coalesced undo/redo via keyboard and toolbar.
acceptance: Every operation leaves validateModel() empty
Cross-block deleteRange joins first and last blocks
Undo restores the exact prior state; a typing burst is one undo step
Enter at end of heading starts a paragraph; mid-heading keeps the remainder a heading
knownLimitations: End-to-end tests cover boot/render; full input-simulation E2E not yet automated — status stays below verified
Undo is operation-log based since ADR-0009 (Slides deck still snapshot-based)

name: Structural Formatting Inspector (Reveal Codes)
description: Ordered formatting codes in document order; click a code to select its exact range; explain why formatting applies at the caret.
acceptance: Inspector matches canonical document structure (text codes reconstruct docText exactly)
Mark on/off codes are balanced
Code click selects the affected document range
explainAt names block type and active marks at any offset
knownLimitations: Inspector is read+navigate; §6.2.3 in-panel code editing not yet implemented

name: Autosave journal and crash recovery
description: Debounced autosave of the full document after each quiescent edit; reload restores the last confirmed state; corrupt journals fail safe without overwriting until the next successful edit.
acceptance: Reload after editing restores the document
Corrupt or version-mismatched journal yields a fresh document plus a user-visible notice, never a crash
No save occurs before the first edit (recovery journal is not clobbered on boot)

evidence.ref: smoke test asserts no premature save on boot

knownLimitations: localStorage journal (ADR-0001); IndexedDB/SQLite is the recorded path
restore round-trip not yet covered by an automated reload test

name: Export with per-format loss reporting
description: Export native JSON (lossless), HTML (lossless for the model subset), and Markdown; lossy Markdown exports present a loss report and require confirmation before a destructive export (§5.3).
acceptance: JSON round-trip is byte-equal on the model
Markdown export of underlined text is flagged MD-UNDERLINE-LOST and never claimed lossless
fromJSON rejects unsupported schema versions and invalid structures
knownLimitations: DOCX/ODT/PDF converters not yet implemented; they join the same loss-report pipeline (§5.2)

name: Durable multi-document store with Files surface
description: Multiple named documents in IndexedDB (localStorage and in-memory fallbacks with user-visible durability class); document list, rename, create, delete; one-time migration of the v1 journal.
edgeCases: legacy journal retired only after successful migration
acceptance: Fresh boot seeds and persists a document; list shows it
v1 journal imports once and is removed only after the new save succeeds
Degraded storage is reported to the user, never silent
knownLimitations: IndexedDB path exercised in browsers, not in jsdom CI (falls back to localStorage there)

name: DOCX export/import with loss reports
description: Export the document as a .docx package; open .docx files mapping paragraphs, Heading1/2, bold/italic/underline; every unsupported construct is kept where possible and reported, never silently dropped.
edgeCases: hyperlink text kept, target reported lost
acceptance: Export → import round-trip preserves structure, text, and marks for the model subset
Import of unsupported content yields DOCX-IMPORT-* warnings and keeps the text
Non-DOCX and corrupt input fails loudly
knownLimitations: Fixture corpus is self-generated + synthetic; no real-Word differential corpus yet (§22.2), so status stays below verified
No Original Format Preservation store yet: import is one-way into the native model

name: PDF export with deterministic pagination
description: Export the document as a paginated PDF: proportional Helvetica by default using verified base-14 AFM metrics (Courier optional); charset losses replaced and reported.
acceptance: xref entries resolve to their objects
identical input yields identical bytes
independent parser (pypdf) extracts the text across pages

evidence.ref: pypdf cross-validation: 4-page sample parsed, text extracted
measure-based line-width proof + pypdf re-validation (Helvetica, 3 pages)

knownLimitations: Base-14 fonts only (no embedding/subsetting); no PDF reading, forms, signatures, or PDF/A yet

name: Reveal Codes in-panel editing
description: Remove a formatting span from its on/off code (maximal adjoining span) and retype a block from its block code, through a controlled interface that translates code actions into model operations.
edgeCases: mark-off codes target the span ending there
acceptance: remove-mark strips exactly the adjoining span and keeps validateModel empty
set-block-type retypes only the named block
unsupported combinations change nothing
knownLimitations: Code-level editing covers marks and block types; field/section codes do not exist in the v0 model yet

name: Command registry and palette
description: CommandDefinition registry (stable ids, names, availability predicates, undo contract, audit classification) surfaced through a Ctrl/Cmd-K palette with filtering and keyboard navigation; one implementation per command shared with the toolbar.
edgeCases: unavailable commands (undo with empty history) are hidden
acceptance: Ctrl/Cmd-K opens; filter narrows; Enter runs the selected command through the canonical path
knownLimitations: File/export commands run via their wired controls; full registry inversion (controls calling the registry) is the recorded next step

name: Named revisions with compare and restore
description: Save named restorable revisions with the document; block-level comparison (LCS over stable block ids) distinguishing text from formatting-only changes; restore is undoable; unreadable revisions fail safe.
edgeCases: split shows changed+added, not a cascade
acceptance: diffModels matches blocks by id via LCS; summary counts correct on edit/split/delete
Compare panel reports counts and per-block changes
Restore recovers the revision and is undoable
knownLimitations: Block-granularity diff (no intra-block run diff yet); review branches/merge not yet built; revisions are full copies until op-log migration

name: Operation-log undo/redo
description: All document mutations decompose into five invertible primitives recorded in a transaction log; undo replays inverses, redo replays originals; typing coalesces; byte-stable round-trips including block ids.
acceptance: invertOp is an involution for every primitive
Every high-level operation single-op inverts to the exact prior state (ids included)
A mixed 7-step session unwinds and replays through exact intermediate states

evidence.ref: all 84 prior unit tests + 6 smoke scenarios pass unchanged on the op-based engine

knownLimitations: No op serialization/authorship yet (next step toward §14.1 collaboration); Slides deck undo still snapshot-based

name: Operation journal + transform/rebase substrate
description: Serializable attributed op journal (append/replay/compact, schema-validated) and OT over the primitive set with explicit tie-breaks and transaction-granular conflict surfacing; two concurrent replicas converge by rebase. Write records into the journal at runtime: transactions commit on close with actor attribution, undo/redo journal as inverse transactions, the journal persists with the document (compacted past 300 entries) and is replay-verified on open; recent activity is surfaced in the Revisions panel.
offlineSupport: fully offline (substrate; no network layer yet)
acceptance: TP1 convergence (byte-equal, ids included) for every supported primitive pair
Conflicts carry reasons and reject transactions whole
Journal replay deterministic; serialization round-trips; compaction preserves replay
Two replicas recording real operations converge through rebase

evidence.ref: transform.test.ts: 9 suites incl. TP1 matrix + two-replica simulation (100 unit total)
oplog commit-listener suite + smoke scenario 5 (attributed journal persists and parses): pass

knownLimitations: TP2 not claimed (client/relay topology assumed)
No network relay, presence, or conflict UX yet
Actor identity is a local pseudonymous id (no accounts)

name: Bulleted and numbered lists
description: List block types with nesting levels 0-3 (Tab/Shift-Tab, per-level markers 1./a./i./1) and bullet glyphs) through the full pipeline: editing with list continuation and empty-item exit, Reveal Codes, HTML ul/ol, Markdown, OOXML numbering in DOCX both ways, PDF hanging-indent prefixes.
edgeCases: nested DOCX levels flatten with warning
unresolvable numbering falls back with warning
acceptance: Enter continues the list; empty-item Enter exits
DOCX round-trip preserves bullet vs numbered via numbering.xml
python-docx reads exported lists as List Paragraph with numPr

evidence.ref: nested-list suites: ops inversion, HTML nesting validity, MD indentation, DOCX ilvl round-trip

knownLimitations: Nesting capped at 4 levels

name: Tables (atomic blocks)
description: Insert/edit/delete tables as atomic blocks: click-to-edit cells with Tab navigation, row/col controls, invertible journaled set-table operations with OT conflict semantics; HTML/MD/DOCX w:tbl round-trip, ruled PDF grid rendering with per-cell wrap and row pagination.
edgeCases: one undo removes a whole insertion
acceptance: All table operations keep validateModel empty and invert exactly
DOCX export/import round-trips cell data; spans/formatting warn
Smoke: palette insert, cell edit commit, undo restores block count

evidence.ref: tables.test.ts (7 suites) + docx table suites: pass
pdf table grid suites + pypdf validation

knownLimitations: Plain-text cells (no per-cell formatting or nested blocks — ADR-0011 migration recorded)
No spans or column widths yet (PDF grid drawing landed in WO-23)
